description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_Injector_SafeObject, which extends HTMLPurifier_Injector and adds security enhancements related to the safe handling of object and param HTML elements in a sanitize/purify context. It manages stacks of object and param tokens, injects safe param elements, and enforces certain attribute allowances.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Injector_SafeObject
classes.description: A class that modifies object elements in HTML to ensure certain parameters are added and only allowed params are kept, enhancing security during HTML purification.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Initializes the injector with configuration and context, calls parent preparation method.

methods.name: handleElement
methods.description: Processes 'object' and 'param' tokens, adding safe parameters to object elements and validating parameter names.

methods.name: handleEnd
methods.description: Handles the end of object tokens, updating internal stacks accordingly.
